description: The file defines the Opportunity class, which models sales opportunities within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for opportunity fields, relationship handling, data retrieval, export, and saving logic. The class extends SugarBean and interacts with related modules such as Accounts, Contacts, Campaigns, and Currencies.

classes.name: Opportunity
classes.description: Represents a sales opportunity, with properties for fields, relationships, and methods for data operations, export, and relationship management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Opportunity object, setting account requirements based on configuration.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the opportunity, primarily its name.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to retrieve a list of opportunities with optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query for exporting opportunity data with related account and user info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Loads additional data fields for listing, with optional detail loading.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional details like campaign info and related account info.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to the opportunity.

methods.name: update_currency_id
methods.description: Updates the currency information for a list of opportunity IDs.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, including formatted fields.

methods.name: get_currency_symbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol associated with the opportunity.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Creates a WHERE clause based on a search query string for filtering opportunities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the opportunity record, setting default currency and probability.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Manages relationship links, including account and contact relationships.

methods.name: set_opportunity_contact_relationship
methods.description: Associates a contact with the opportunity.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Populates notification template with opportunity data.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for specific interfaces, such as ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines access permissions for list views based on security group and ownership.

methods.name: get_account_detail
methods.description: Retrieves account information related to a given opportunity ID.
